events.title: Demo updated: a reworked interface
events.summary: Hi all, A new demo build is live, and the playtest build has it too. I've reworked the whole interface, so every screen should be cleaner, easier to read and easier to use, on PC and Steam Deck. It was a big change, so if anything looks wrong or a button doesn't respond, please tell me on the Discord, ideally with a screenshot: https://discord.com/invite/5dJ4jXQy8P Thank you for playing. Nico

events.title: Demo updated: fairer scavenging, and choices that come back round
events.summary: Hi all, If you haven't come across Mercyrail yet: Britain fell a year ago, and you're running the last train out of Waterloo, heading north across the real UK rail network towards a rumoured place called Haven. You decide who gets a seat, send your crew into empty towns for supplies, and try to keep everyone alive along the way. The demo is free, and it's part of Steam Next Fest until 26 October.
